items.text: Livestock now have a water need and will seek out nearby water sources such as containers, rivers, or lakes to drink.
Tool cupboard upkeep cost now scales with player count: first 4 players add 0% upkeep, next 6 add 2% each, additional players add 4% each; deauth removal takes 24 hours.

2026-08-24.summary:
### Animals & AI
- Livestock now have a water need and will seek out nearby water sources such as containers, rivers, or lakes to drink.

### Tool Cupboard & Upkeep
- Tool cupboard upkeep cost now scales with player count: first 4 players add 0% upkeep, next 6 add 2% each, additional players add 4% each; deauth removal takes 24 hours.

items.text: Fixed heavy scientists getting stuck after being dropped by the helicopter on certain seeds (small oilrig).

Fixed mismatched colliders and off‑center gib origins for multiple deployables (io.table, HotAirBalloon armor, sculpture.ice, mannequin, chandelier, component.box.charcoal.large, HotAirBalloon basket, refinery, windmill, wooden box, fireplace, lift shaft top, tool cupboard, cannon, component box wood), eliminating clipping and improving break‑apart physics.

2026-08-22.summary:
